//: The academy (M6 phase D; game/challenge.ts runs it like a challenge): lessons in order, each passed with bronze to open the next. kind: timing (a point for each ball you hit Good or Perfect), shot (a point for each ball you play with `shot` that comes down in their court), glass (a point for each ball you play back in after it came off your own glass); the coach's feeds come from the practice drill named. vision: how much of the ball's path off the glass is drawn (2 all of it, 1 where it meets the glass and where it comes down, 0 none). autoTiming false: the lesson is played with your own timing whatever the setting. {drive} and the like are the keys in use.

lessons.name: Timing
lessons.desc: Hold {drive} as the ball comes: the ring closes on it and the meter runs to the middle. Let go as they meet. Good or Perfect counts.

lessons.name: The drive
lessons.desc: {drive} hits flat and through the ball. Land it in their court.

lessons.name: Topspin
lessons.desc: {topspin} brushes up the back of the ball: it dips over the net and kicks off the floor.

lessons.name: Slice
lessons.desc: {slice} cuts under the ball: low over the net, skidding, safe.

lessons.name: The lob
lessons.desc: {lob} sends the ball high over a pair at the net, down towards their back glass.

lessons.name: The drop
lessons.desc: {drop}: soft, just over the net, dying before they reach it.

lessons.name: Volleys
lessons.desc: At the net, {volley} takes the ball in the air before it bounces: punch it back deep.

lessons.name: The bandeja
lessons.desc: A lob over you at the net: {overhead} plays the bandeja, flat and deep, so you keep the net.

lessons.name: The víbora
lessons.desc: {overhead} with {precision} is the víbora: sidespin, cross-court into their side glass.

lessons.name: The smash
lessons.desc: {overhead} with {power}: the smash. A short lob is your chance to finish the point.

lessons.name: The back glass
lessons.desc: Let the ball come off your back glass. The line shows its path off the glass: be where it comes down, take it as it drops, play it back in.

lessons.name: Side glass
lessons.desc: Wide balls into the side glass and the corners. Only where it meets the glass and where it comes down are shown now.

lessons.name: Read the glass
lessons.desc: The same balls, nothing drawn: read them yourself.
